description: This file provides functions to generate various calendar links (Google Calendar, Microsoft Office, Outlook, ICS) for booking events, including handling recurring events and dynamic event names.

methods.name: buildICalLink
methods.description: Generates an iCalendar (.ics) file data URI for an event with specified start/end times, title, description, and location.

methods.name: buildGoogleCalendarLink
methods.description: Constructs a Google Calendar event edit URL with event details and optional recurrence.

methods.name: buildMicrosoftOfficeLink
methods.description: Constructs a Microsoft Office calendar event URL with event details.

methods.name: buildMicrosoftOutlookLink
methods.description: Constructs a Microsoft Outlook calendar event URL with event details.

methods.name: getCalendarLinks
methods.description: Main exported function that generates multiple calendar links (Google, Microsoft Office, Outlook, ICS) for a booking, considering event type, recurrence, and dynamic naming.
